summary: Login fix verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass. All 4 accounts log in, ' Kellner1 '/'Kellner123! ' -> 200, leading-space password -> 200, wrong password / wrong-case password / unknown user -> 401 with 'falsch'. Frontend (375x667): for all 3 role cards, Demo-Zugang einsetzen fills the correct username and password, and Anmelden goes to the right home (/waiter tables grid, /kitchen Bestellungen, /owner Speisekarte). Logout returns to /login. The eye toggle switches the input type password -> text -> password and is 44x44. Typing ' Kellner2 ' / 'Kellner123! ' by hand logs in as Kellner 2. A wrong password shows login-error-text 'Benutzername oder Passwort falsch'. The Enter key submits. Submit is disabled when the password is empty. No deprecated Expo packages were seen in the login screen.

issues: On a 375px screen the 'Fertig' filter tab is cut off at the right edge (it probably scrolls sideways). Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: Both sides trim the password. Passwords that really start or end with a space can never match. This is fine for the current seeded accounts, but keep it in mind for future password-setting features.
The selected role card is only a UI hint. Picking 'Küche' and typing kellner1 logs in as a waiter. This is probably intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run the backend login tests with: export $(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env) && pytest tests/test_login_trim.py. Logout buttons: waiter-logout-button, kitchen-logout-button, owner-logout-button (no confirm dialog).
rca_of_issue: The user's 'Benutzername oder Passwort falsch' was most likely caused by trailing spaces or auto-capitalization from the emulator keyboard. The fix trims and lowercases the username, trims the password on frontend and backend, and adds the demo-fill button and the eye toggle. Each of these cases was tested and works.
